## Reading question

How much of the modelled difference in word reading between the immediate-intervention and wait-list arms is associated with their difference in phonics skills? The primary analysis uses available observations from baseline (t1) to the end of the randomised waiting period (t2). A positive word-reading contrast favours the immediate-intervention arm. Model `lrp-rli-med-059` uses letter-sound knowledge alone as its mediator. This model adds phoneme blending.

## Measuring phonics skills {#sec-composite}

The mediator gives equal weight to letter-sound knowledge and phoneme blending. Each score is transformed to a corrected logit and standardised using its t2 distribution. The model averages the two values and standardises the average, applying the same scaling to baseline scores. A normal model describes the t2 composite. A Beta-Binomial model describes the t2 word-reading score and allows the composite's association with reading to differ by treatment arm.

The mediator and outcome models both condition on baseline word reading, the baseline composite, age, expressive and receptive vocabulary, hearing, phonological memory and speech production. Missingness indicators accompany hearing, memory and speech production.

## Interpreting the decomposition {#sec-assumptions}

The posterior g-formula divides the total word-reading contrast into a component through the composite (NIE) and a residual component (NDE). The residual includes everything outside the measured composite. It cannot identify a lexical or whole-word reading strategy. The ratio NIE / total can be unstable when the total is close to zero. Read the components in word-reading items alongside their intervals in the fitted report.

Randomisation assigned children to immediate or delayed intervention. A causal interpretation of the split would also require temporal ordering and control of common causes of phonics and reading. Both skills are measured at t2, latent general ability can influence both, and treatment assignment affects the dose of teaching each child receives. These features leave the natural direct and indirect effects unidentified. The sensitivity fit uses the t2 composite and t3 reading after crossover. It puts the two measurements in time order while also changing the follow-up interval and treatment received.
